 Cancer Council Shows There’s More To Every Bottle In New Campaign Via TRP
 Published on: 19th November 2026 at 12:21 PM 
 Edited by 
 Staff Writers 
 Share 
 3 Min Read 
 --> 
 Cancer Council’s new summer sun protection campaign, created by TRP, highlights how every one of its branded products contributes to something bigger, helping support Cancer Council’s mission to reduce the impact of cancer for all Australians. 
 ‘Every Bottle Does More’ draws on a simple insight: what people know about an organisation’s expertise shapes their confidence in its products. By showing the work behind every bottle, Cancer Council reminds Australians that its sunscreen is backed by decades of expertise in sun safety. It also highlighted how every purchase supports Cancer Council’s work to reduce the impact of cancer.
 The campaign featured Cancer Council’s broader licensed portfolio, including hats, sunglasses, swimwear, shade and tint products, to demonstrate how the comprehensive range of sun protection solutions helps Australians protect themselves every day.
 “The Cancer Council brand appears across a range of products that support Australians every day, from sunscreen and hats through to shade, swimwear and sunglasses. This campaign brings that portfolio together under a shared purpose, helping consumers better understand the connection between the products they purchase and Cancer Council’s wider mission,” said Cancer Council Australia head of brand licensing and corporate partnerships Arianne Reisner.
 “As Cancer Council’s sunscreen partner, we know the confidence people place in the name when choosing sun protection. ‘Every Bottle Does More’ gives Australians a fuller picture of what that name stands for, reinforcing trust in the products while showing how their purchase supports Cancer Council’s wider work,” said Vitality Brands Worldwide general manager of marketing and digital Lucinda Sabo.
 “People know Cancer Council sunscreen. The real opportunity was to reveal more of the organisation behind it. Every bottle of sunscreen is backed by decades of work to prevent and treat cancer. ‘Every Bottle Does More’ magnifies that connection, giving Australians another reason to choose Cancer Council,” said TRP head of strategy Kyle Ross.
 The campaign has launched across streaming TV, video platforms, social and out-of-home.
